newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse shut on holiday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse shut on holiday.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange was closed on Wednesday for the celebrations of Pakistan's founder Mohammad Ali Jinnah's birthday, one broker said.
The market will reopen on Sunday after Thursday's local religious holiday and the Friday and Saturday weekend.
The exchange's 100-share price index closed 3.15 points, or 0.23 percent, higher on Tuesday amid 146 losers and 97 gainers in a turnover of 24 million, up from Monday's 22 million.
